name: send_message
description: Send text to one or more correspondents by ID. Each call submits one message and returns a submission reference; submission does not confirm recipient delivery.

name: fork_session
description: Open another focus of your attention to pursue the supplied task while your activation continues. Return its stable session_id. The activity inherits your retained history, including this complete model/tool round. Its new assistant text accompanies your later ordinary inputs without activating you; its ending requests an input even without new text.

name: send_session_message
description: Send a message to an existing session. The message is durably queued as an observation. A dormant recipient becomes ready; an active recipient receives it between complete model/tool rounds.

session_id.description: The current roster lists existing sessions.

name: wakeup
description: Leave yourself something to return to at a later time. Schedule one observation for the core and return its callback_id; the arrangement survives restart. Past times are due immediately, though inference can occur later.

at_unix_ms.description: Current runtime time is supplied in state.

text.description: What to reconsider when this observation arrives.
